attempts.summary: Installed and configured dnsmasq on node1 as an internal DNS resolver that maps inventory-api.internal → node2 (10.100.159.11), forwarding all other queries upstream, opened firewalld's dns service, and configured node2 (via NetworkManager) to use node1 (10.100.159.10) as its DNS resolver. Verified resolution both before and after safely restarting each node one at a time (boot identity confirmed changed on both), preserving inter-node connectivity throughout.
